name: Indian Sign Language
alphabet_description: ISL utilizes a distinct fingerspelling system influenced by both regional conventions and two-handed configurations for consonants, with specific orientations for vowels.

alphabet.description: Closed fist with thumb upright alongside the index finger.
alphabet.tip: Rest thumb firmly along side of index

alphabet.description: Flat non-dominant hand held palm facing right; dominant flat hand touches palm at right angle.
Curved C-shape formed by thumb and fingers with wide aperture.
Non-dominant index finger points upward vertically; dominant thumb and index form semicircle touching its tip and base.
alphabet.tip: Creates closed loop on vertical bar

alphabet.description: Dominant index finger points to the tip of non-dominant index finger.
Index and middle fingers of dominant hand crossed horizontally over index and middle of non-dominant hand.
Both hands closed into fists placed together with dominant fist resting on non-dominant fist.
Non-dominant palm flat horizontal; dominant palm slides flat across it from wrist to fingertips.
Dominant index finger points to the tip of non-dominant middle finger.
Dominant index touches tip of non-dominant middle finger, then traces small curved hook downward.
Non-dominant index pointing upright; dominant index finger hooked sideways touching knuckle of non-dominant index.
Thumb and index extended at right angle forming clear L shape; remaining fingers curled.
Dominant three fingers (index, middle, ring) rest across palm of non-dominant flat hand.
Dominant two fingers (index, middle) rest across palm of non-dominant flat hand.
Dominant index finger points to the tip of non-dominant ring finger.
Non-dominant index finger upright; dominant thumb and index form closed circle touching index tip.
alphabet.tip: Round loop on top of post

alphabet.description: Non-dominant hand forms circle with thumb and index; dominant index hooks into base of circle.
Dominant hooked index finger rests over non-dominant flat palm.
Little fingers of both hands linked or hooked together at chest level.
Dominant index finger taps edge of non-dominant flat palm near thumb joint.
Dominant index finger points to the tip of non-dominant pinky finger.
Index and middle fingers extended apart in V shape; thumb holds down ring and pinky.
Index, middle, and ring fingers extended apart forming W; thumb holds pinky.
Index fingers of both hands crossed over each other at right angles.
Thumb and pinky extended outward widely; middle three fingers curled firmly into palm.
Index finger extended, tracing zigzag Z trajectory through air.

vocabulary.label: HELLO
vocabulary.description: Dominant open hand placed near forehead/temple and arced smoothly outward in greeting.

vocabulary.label: GOODBYE
vocabulary.description: Open hand raised at chest level oscillating side to side.

vocabulary.label: THANK_YOU
vocabulary.description: Flat open hand touching chin/mouth, moving gently outward toward person.
vocabulary.hand_orientation: palm inward touching chin, then tilting forward

vocabulary.label: PLEASE
vocabulary.description: Open flat palm gently rubbing in a circular motion on the chest.

vocabulary.label: SORRY
vocabulary.description: Closed fist gently rotating over the heart/chest area.

vocabulary.label: HELP
vocabulary.description: Non-dominant flat palm facing up; dominant fist with thumb upright placed on palm and lifted together.
vocabulary.hand_orientation: base palm up, top hand fist with thumb up

vocabulary.label: YES
vocabulary.description: Fist held upright and tilted forward/downward in an affirmative nod.

vocabulary.label: NO
vocabulary.description: Index and middle fingers snapping or pressing against the thumb horizontally.
vocabulary.hand_orientation: fingers extended then snapping to thumb

vocabulary.label: WATER
vocabulary.description: Hand forming a 'W' or cup shape tapping gently at the corner of the mouth/chin.

vocabulary.label: FOOD
vocabulary.description: Flattened O-shape hand brought repeatedly near the mouth.

vocabulary.label: I
vocabulary.description: Index finger pointing directly at the center of the chest.

vocabulary.label: YOU
vocabulary.description: Index finger pointing forward directly toward conversational partner/camera.

vocabulary.label: MY
vocabulary.description: Open flat palm placed gently flat on the center of the chest.

vocabulary.label: WHAT
vocabulary.description: Both open hands held out with palms facing upward, shaking gently side to side.

vocabulary.label: WHERE
vocabulary.description: Index finger pointed upward, wagging gently left to right in an inquiring motion.

numbers.description: Index finger extended upright, thumb holding other fingers.
Index and middle fingers extended upright and together or slightly spread.
Thumb, index, and middle fingers extended upright; ring and pinky curled.
Four fingers upright and spread, thumb tucked across palm.
Open flat hand with all five fingers spread widely.
Dominant hand shows 1 (index), non-dominant hand shows open 5.
Dominant hand shows 2 (index, middle), non-dominant hand shows open 5.
Dominant hand shows 3, non-dominant hand shows open 5.
Dominant hand shows 4, non-dominant hand shows open 5.
Both hands open with all 10 fingers spread facing forward.
